purpose: Do an action again to correct or improve its result.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
I asked again because I had not heard.
We need to rethink the plan.
restrictions: The second attempt repairs or revises the first; not merely a repeated habit.
mistake: 読み直す is reread; 直す also has an independent repair meaning.
